Mediabunny 1.66.2
Unmodified source files and license: https://registry.npmjs.org/mediabunny/-/mediabunny-1.66.2.tgz
Repository: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny
The MPL 2.0 license is included in mediabunny.LICENSE.txt.

The browser bundle uses esbuild 0.28.2 with
--bundle --minify --format=esm --platform=browser --legal-comments=inline --target=safari16.4
and an entry exporting BlobSource, BufferTarget, Conversion, Input, MP4,
Mp4OutputFormat, Output, QTFF, and WEBM from mediabunny.
